notes.title: Carrier Deck Update to V1.1.1 on Open Beta !!
notes.content:
Improved feedback for invalid launches
Improved mission launching mechanism where missions can be launched without needing to select units
Changed cargo missions to immediately add Logistics mission on landing
Missions no longer have to be launched in their order in the mission queue
Reduced number of slots in the mission queue to 3
Missions in queue show chevrons when the mission is ready to launch
Aircraft can turn around on elevators
Removed unnecessary loadout options from loadout radial on Greyhound, Hawkeye and Osprey
Improved damage effects on units
Changed Abort Mission behaviour to be a once off deferral rather than ditching the aircraft and launching a rescue mission
Fixed mouse clicks not being recognised on some occasions

HOW TO UPDATE TO V1.1.1 Open Beta

In your Steam Library, right-click "Carrier Deck" and select “Properties.”
Select the “Betas” tab.
The Beta tag "Beta - Open Beta" will appear in the Beta dropdown list. Select it and close the Properties window.
Steam should now update "Carrier Deck" to the beta version. 

If the update does not start automatically, launch the game to force the update process or...
Select "Local Files" tab
Select "Verify Intergrity of Game Files"

notes.title: Carrier Deck patch to V1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added clear feedback when player attempting an invalid launch
- Reduced sensitivity of the click-and-hold radial menu
- Increased the amount of time a traffic jam has to get unstuck before returning 
  to previous positions
- Fixed South Pacific mission 01 failing after Carrier is hit once
- Fixed submarine bug in North Atlantic mission 04
- Stopped rescue missions jumping the mission queue
- Renamed Cancel button in camera presets to Deck for clarity
- Lt level in Quick and Survival game modes modified for a more 'paced' game
- Fixed Alt-Tabbing removing unit colors
- Reduced Bloom Effect on explosions
